description: Use this first, or when someone asks 'can you check prices, Walmart orders, refunds, or a marketplace offer against our policy?'. It lists the eleven commerce-action preflights, including the four finance families of the opt-in commerce-preflight-v2 contract that requires a matching backend, the Walmart connection and order-path mappings, the separate Dynamics 365 guard, and the Microsoft Partner Center and AWS Marketplace SaaS offer-submission preflight. It also explains PROCEED, HOLD, and BLOCK, configuration, evidence tools, and the requirements for optional agent write proposals. Its non-writing guarantees apply to the eight default tools. This local diagnostic never calls the Decionis API, reveals credentials, or confirms that a backend or platform connector is ready to execute an action.
